person.name: Alfonso de la Rocha
person.tagline: From telecom networks to blockchains, cryptography, distributed systems and data infrastructure for AI.

phases.label: Academia
phases.theme: Cloud energy, video coding and secure routing
phases.summary: Telecom engineering at UPM, a double MSc with KTH, and research on green data centres and on securing BGP. Securing BGP is where I first met blockchains.

phases.label: Industry
phases.summary: Chatbots and then blockchain at Minsait, Spain's national blockchain network Alastria, and cryptography R&D at Telefónica: TrustOS, five patents and two hackathon prizes.

phases.label: Protocol research
phases.summary: Research engineer at Protocol Labs: content routing for IPFS, the Filecoin network indexer, and leading IPC from an open research problem to mainnet.

phases.label: Entrepreneurship
phases.summary: Co-founded Finisterra Labs and built Baselight, a structured data layer for agents and humans. Raised $3.75M, was acquired by Chainalysis, and now works on its AI team while co-founding Shellment.

items.label: KTH + UPM · Double MSc
items.title: Double degree: MSc Electrical Engineering & MSc Telecommunication Engineering
items.org: KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Stockholm) & Universidad Politécnica de Madrid
items.detail: Thesis with Ericsson Research on adaptive loop filters for next-generation video coding, graded cum laude.

items.label: GreenStack · UPM
items.title: Research collaborator, GreenLSI group
items.detail: Put the group's prediction models and energy-aware VM allocation policies into OpenStack. Measured energy savings on real cloud deployments.

items.label: KTH · Secure routing
items.title: Research fellow, Networked Systems Security group
items.detail: With Prof. Panos Papadimitratos: a blockchain-based PKI to secure inter-domain routing (BGP). Published at iNetSec 2017. Blockchains solved our problem of distributing identity and trust without a central authority, which is how I entered the space.

items.label: Ericsson · Video coding
items.title: Researcher (MSc thesis)
items.detail: Explored how the objective gains of adaptive loop filters in next-generation MPEG codecs translate into perceived quality, and developed an algorithm that improved compression further. Led to a patent filing.

items.label: ResNetLab
items.title: Resilient Networks Lab
items.detail: Beyond Bitswap: research on faster file exchange in IPFS and Filecoin. Findings were folded into the libp2p roadmap.

items.label: Filecoin Core
items.title: Filecoin core engineering
items.detail: Built the InterPlanetary Network Indexer (storetheindex, go-storethehash, index-provider). It makes every CID stored on Filecoin discoverable in real time at cid.contact.

items.label: ConsensusLab · IPC
items.title: ConsensusLab
items.detail: Led the design and implementation of IPC (InterPlanetary Consensus): hierarchical, EVM-compatible subnets on Filecoin, taken from open research to mainnet in Rust and Go.

items.label: Abundance · Sharding
items.title: Part-time researcher, sharding design
items.detail: Worked with Nazar Mokrynskyi on the sharding design of a new blockchain: draft specs for sharded archiving, data availability sampling, shard block proofs and farmer membership allocation, plus weekly research updates on the project blog.

items.label: Minsait · Chatbots → blockchain
items.title: Technical lead
items.detail: Led an intrapreneurial chatbot team (Rasa, spaCy, Watson) and then Minsait's blockchain team. Represented Indra's technical strategy in the Alastria consortium.

items.label: Telefónica · Blockchain & crypto R&D
items.title: Blockchain technological expert
items.detail: Designed core blockchain, cryptography and digital identity technology across Telefónica units. Conceived TrustOS, which is still in production. Contributed to Hyperledger Labs' TrustID. Technical referent in cryptography.

items.label: Protocol Labs · Research engineer
items.title: Research engineer
items.detail: Four years across ResNetLab, Filecoin core and ConsensusLab. Four peer-reviewed papers and talks across Europe and North America.

items.label: Chainalysis · Staff SWE, AI
items.title: Staff software engineer, AI team
items.detail: Joined through the acquisition of Finisterra Labs / Baselight.

items.label: LastBasic · CTO
items.title: Chief technical officer
items.detail: Designed and built the technical platform and set the technology strategy for a startup that turns hardware prototypes into products.

items.label: Finisterra Labs · Baselight
items.title: Co-founder & CTO
items.detail: Built Baselight, a structured data layer for AI: 400B+ rows across 68K+ datasets, a natural-language query interface with citations, and an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini. Led a team of 12. Raised $3.75M led by Haun Ventures. Acquired by Chainalysis in 2026.

items.label: Shellment · CTO
items.title: Co-founder & CTO
items.detail: Took the platform from zero to a live v1, with 200+ KYC-verified users in the first week. Evolved through an AI-driven SDLC instead of a dedicated engineering team.

items.label: Wayra · Tech due diligence
items.title: Technical advisor
items.detail: Technical advice and due diligence on startups for Telefónica's accelerator and venture arm.

items.label: FilOz · F3
items.title: Advisor & hands-on engineer
items.detail: Helped test and harden Filecoin's new fast finality gadget (F3) ahead of launch. F3 shipped in 2025 and cut Filecoin's finality from 7.5 hours to minutes.

items.label: Universidad Europea
items.title: Lecturer
items.detail: Taught several editions between 2018 and 2024.

items.label: Inesdi / ThreePoints
items.title: Professor, Master's in Fintech & Financial Innovation
items.detail: Taught the token development and cryptography modules.

items.label: IBM Watson AI XPRIZE
items.title: AI developer, Primex team
items.detail: Coordinated the team's TensorFlow developers and built seq2seq chatbots and RNN-based user profiling.

items.label: Alastria
items.title: Platform technical team
items.detail: Core contributor: wrote the node monitor in Go, built the test environment and ran the AIP improvement-proposal process.

items.label: Coinmonks
items.title: Technical writer
items.detail: Technical posts on blockchain and distributed systems.

items.label: @adlrocha newsletter
items.title: Author, @adlrocha newsletter
items.detail: A long-running newsletter on distributed systems, cryptography, AI and the future of computing, started while at Telefónica. 720+ subscribers.

items.label: AI Socratic Madrid
items.title: Co-host & ambassador
items.detail: Co-host of the Madrid chapter of AI Socratic, a network of AI engineers.
